title: Learning as Deepfakes Evolve: RF-Prompt for Continual Audio Deepfake Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.37586v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continual audio deepfake detection requires learning newly emerging deepfake methods while retaining discrimination of previously encountered speech. Existing dataset-incremental evaluation changes both real-speech domains and deepfake mechanisms, making their effects difficult to distinguish. We construct five task organizations over identical training, development, and evaluation pools to study these factors under a controlled sample budget. Our proposed Real-Anchored Mechanism-Incremental (RAMI) protocol reflects the practical setting in which available real speech provides a recurring mixed-domain reference while new deepfake mechanisms arrive incrementally. We further propose RF-Prompt, an asymmetric continual prompt-learning method that preserves reusable real-speech knowledge through a shared real prompt and expands mechanism-specific knowledge through inherited fake experts with orthogonal residuals. Input-adaptive soft fusion

translated_title: 随深度伪造演化而学习：用于持续音频深度伪造检测的RF-Prompt
translated_abstract: 持续音频深度伪造检测要求在学习新出现的深度伪造方法的同时，保持对先前遇到语音的判别能力。现有的数据集增量评估同时改变了真实语音域和深度伪造机制，使得两者的影响难以区分。我们在相同的训练、开发和评估数据池上构建了五种任务组织，以便在受控样本预算下研究这些因素。我们提出的真实锚定机制增量协议反映了实际应用场景：可用的真实语音提供反复出现的混合域参考，而新的深度伪造机制则增量到来。我们进一步提出RF-Prompt，这是一种非对称的持续提示学习方法，通过共享的真实提示保留可复用的真实语音知识，并通过带正交残差的继承式伪造专家扩展机制特定的知识，同时采用输入自适应软融合。
tldr: 该论文提出了RAMI评估协议和RF-Prompt非对称持续提示学习方法，通过共享真实提示保留真实语音知识、通过带正交残差的继承式伪造专家扩展新机制知识，实现在持续应对新深度伪造技术的同时保持对已见语音的判别能力。
